name: synthesize and normalize a multitone audio and write a 16-bit wav
definition: generate a mono 16 kHz short signal as a sum of several fixed sines, add a dither, then RMS-normalize to a target level and quantize to 16-bit PCM saved in a wav file.
failure_mode: RMS outside the tolerance band or a missing spectral peak fails property checks

name: train a reinforcement-learning policy to a strong reward threshold
definition: Train a policy on the described control environment with the permitted library versions so it attains a high mean episode reward.
failure_mode: Under-trained policy or wrong env/library leads to low mean reward.
